title: Quantization Amplifies Determinism, Not Bias: Scale-Dependent Behavioral Effects of Serving-Time Weight Compression

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model outputs on country-eliciting prompts across 11 domains to measure the tendency to stereotypically default to specific countries (e.g., Japan) and computing pull-target compliance.
Using brand-blind car recommendation scenarios to assess whether models systematically favor particular car brands (stereotype direction) versus simply collapsing to a non-stereotypical modal answer.
